I'm a Statistics M.A. student at UC Berkeley with five years of industry experience at McKinsey and Deloitte. My work sits at the intersection of rigorous statistical modeling and practical decision-making — from clinical prediction rules in pediatric medicine to causal inference in large-scale A/B experiments.

Before Berkeley, I built large-scale ETL pipelines, data warehouse architectures, and analytics products used by enterprise clients across Latin America. I came back to graduate school to formalize the foundations behind the models I was already shipping.

**Open to data science and applied scientist roles starting December 2026.** [Get in touch](mailto:ricardoperez@berkeley.edu)
